semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor equipment and automation solutions for the industry.
summary: Beijing Reje Automation Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on providing innovative automated transport solutions for the semiconductor industry. With a strong customer base and a comprehensive product line, including cleanroom robots and automated loading platforms, the company plays a crucial role in enhancing manufacturing efficiency.
capabilities: Automated transport solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
Automated loading platforms (Load Port, SMIF Port)

regional_presence.China: The company has its headquarters in Beijing, a manufacturing base in Tianjin, and sales and service support in Shanghai, along with branch offices in several other cities.
